summary.headline: Hanshin Construction wins KRW 149.56bn redevelopment contract in Siheung-dong, Seoul
summary.what_happened: Hanshin Construction Co., Ltd. disclosed on Nov 27, 2026 that it signed a construction contract for the Siheung 1-dong 864-1 and surrounding area street-home redevelopment project in Siheung-dong, Geumcheon-gu, Seoul. The counterparty is the Siheung 1-dong 864-1 Street-Home Redevelopment Project Association. The contract is payable on a progress-payment basis, with no advance payment, and the construction period is stated as 36 months from the actual construction start date.
summary.why_it_matters: Major supply contract disclosures in Korea report newly won orders above set size thresholds, so investors can see the size of a contract relative to the company's recent sales. The stated amount and payment terms can change as construction progresses, so the figures in such filings are not always final.
